# Chainslist — EVM Network Registry Reference

> The open registry of chain IDs, RPC endpoints and network settings for every EVM chain. Add a network to your wallet in one click — keyless and non-custodial.

## Key Facts
- Registry of chain IDs, RPC URLs, currency symbols and block explorers for EVM networks
- One-click "Add to wallet" plus manual add-network values
- Public RPC endpoints are keyless — no API key or account required
- Non-custodial: never holds funds or asks for a private key
- Chain ID examples: Ethereum 1, Polygon 137, Arbitrum One 42161, Base 8453
- Works with MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Rabby, Coinbase Wallet and any EVM wallet
